`Shared/Finance/Reporting/2026/06 June/June executive performance review - WORKING.pptx`

Natalie needs the June executive performance review ready for the leadership meeting. Start with the Q2 board, lender, and investor-relations correspondence in `Requests/`, including the source-tie follow-up. Tie the posted year-to-date revenue population to Vista ERP through the contractor-accounting MCP, while keeping plan and forecast values tied to their controlling finance sources.

Keep the existing nine-slide master, section order, and title slide. Replace the unfinished content on slides 2 through 9 with a concise executive story: executive takeaways; revenue bridge; adjusted EBITDA bridge; business-unit scorecard; cash conversion and working capital; backlog and outlook; risks, opportunities, owners, and next gates; and numerical tie-out and control sources. Distinguish actual, plan, prior year, and latest forecast. Use consistent units and favorable or unfavorable signs. Make each explanation and action traceable to source data rather than unsupported commentary.

Preserve the current visual hierarchy and readable executive density. Add source footnotes where the template calls for them, complete the final numerical tie-out, render and review every slide, and save the finished deck to the exact target path. Do not leave draft files or temporary exports in the shared workspace.
